scope: Independent read-only verification on retained exclusively synthetic owned sandbox
catalogQuery: select c.relname,c.relrowsecurity from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='identity_private' and c.relkind='r' order by c.relname; select count(*) from identity_private.profile_versions; select count(*) from auth.users; select count(*) from storage.objects; select has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.auth_save_private_identity(uuid,integer,text,text,text,text)','execute'); select has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.auth_read_private_identity()','execute');
